24696-the-daughter-of-a-magnate.description: A book by Frank H. Spearman. "It's a pity, too," declared Conductor O'Brien, who was acting as mountain Baedeker, "that we're held back this way when we're covering the prettiest stretch on the road for running. It is right along here where you are riding that the speed records of the world have been made.

40950-the-dreamer-of-dreams.title: THE DREAMER of DREAMS
40950-the-dreamer-of-dreams.creator: THE QUEEN of ROUMANIA
40950-the-dreamer-of-dreams.description: A book by THE QUEEN of ROUMANIA. Each day that Eric Gundian had spent within the King's walls his reputation had grown, and he had, all unconsciously, become the Court favourite. His every whim had been an order; and his gay handsome face had been loved by old and young.

arxiv-1905-07299.title: Spectral Metric for Dataset Complexity Assessment Thanks: This work is supported by the FQRNT B1 208594 and Mitacs acceleration IT08995.
arxiv-1905-07299.creator: Frédéric Branchaud-Charron, Andrew Achkar, Pierre-Marc Jodoin
arxiv-1905-07299.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a new measure to gauge the complexity of image classification problems. Given an annotated image dataset, our method computes a complexity measure called the cumulative spectral gradient (CSG) which strongly correlates with the test accuracy of convolutional neural networks (CNN).

arxiv-2011-14205.title: A ∂ ¯ \bar{\partial} -steepest descent method for oscillatory Riemann-Hilbert problems
arxiv-2011-14205.creator: Fudong Wang, Wen-Xiu Ma
arxiv-2011-14205.description: Abstract We study the long-time asymptotic behavior of oscillatory Riemann-Hilbert problems (RHPs) arising in the mKdV hierarchy (reducing from the AKNS hierarchy). Our analysis is based on the idea of ∂ ¯ \bar{\partial} -steepest descent. We consider RHPs generated from the inverse scattering transform of the AKNS hierarchy with weighted Sobolev initial data.

arxiv-2107-07595.title: Resource allocation in a Quantum Key Distribution Network with LEO and GEO trusted-repeaters
arxiv-2107-07595.creator: Milo Grillo 1 , Alexis A. Dowhuszko 2 , Mohammad-Ali Khalighi 3 , and Jyri Hämäläinen 2
arxiv-2107-07595.description: Abstract Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) is a technology that enables the exchange of private encryption keys between two legitimate parties, using protocols that involve quantum mechanics principles. The rate at which secret keys can be exchanged depends on the attenuation that is experienced.

arxiv-2405-08531.title: The TDHF code Sky3D version 1.2 Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2405-08531.creator: Abhishek, Paul Stevenson, Yue Shi, Esra Yüksel, A. S. Umar
arxiv-2405-08531.description: Abstract The Sky3D code has been widely used to describe nuclear ground states, collective vibrational excitations, and heavy-ion collisions. The approach is based on Skyrme forces or related energy density functionals. The static and dynamic equations are solved on a three-dimensional grid, and pairing is been implemented in the BCS approximation.

arxiv-2408-01410.title: Evolution of an effective Hubble constant in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) modified gravity
arxiv-2408-01410.creator: Tiziano Schiavone \from ins:x, Giovanni Montani \from ins:y \from ins:z
arxiv-2408-01410.description: Abstract We investigate the Hubble constant tension within f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) modified gravity in the Jordan frame, focusing on its application to the dynamics of an isotropic Universe. A scalar field, non-minimally coupled to the metric, provides an extra degree of freedom compared to General Relativity.

arxiv-2412-06076.title: Theory of general theta relations, addition formulas, and theta constants identities
arxiv-2412-06076.creator: Kiyoshi Sogo
arxiv-2412-06076.description: Abstract Jacobi’s theta relations among quartic products of theta functions are generalized to those of arbitrary n n products. Igusa’s procedure of derivation is extended to prove such general theta relations, from which we obtain general addition formulas and theta constants identities. To complete the proof, the concept of cycle number λ \lambda is essential.

arxiv-2505-15279.title: Robust Secure Communications in Near-Field ISCAP Systems with Extremely Large-Scale Antenna Array Part of this paper has been presented at IEEE International Symposium on Wireless Communication Systems (ISWCS) 2024 [ 1 ] . Z. Ren is with the Key Laboratory of Wireless-Optical Communications, Chinese
arxiv-2505-15279.creator: Zixiang Ren, Siyao Zhang, Ling Qiu, Derrick Wing Kwan Ng, and Jie Xu
arxiv-2505-15279.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zixiang Ren, Siyao Zhang, Ling Qiu, Derrick Wing Kwan Ng, and Jie Xu. This paper investigates robust secure communications in a near-field integrated sensing, communication, and powering (ISCAP) system, in which the base station (BS) is equipped with an extremely large-scale antenna array (ELAA). In this system, the BS transmits confidential messages to a single legitimate communication user (CU), simultaneously providing wireless power transfer to multiple energy receivers (ERs) and performing point target sensing.

arxiv-2508-12529.creator: Tin Long Sunny Wong, Lars Bildsten
arxiv-2508-12529.description: Abstract Following a type Ia supernova (SN Ia) in a double white dwarf (WD) binary, a surviving WD companion leaves at its orbital velocity ≈ 1 \approx 1 ,000–3,000 km/s. The Gaia mission has discovered seven such hypervelocity WDs with inflated radii indicative of shock heating by SN ejecta. We study the interaction between SN ejecta and Roche lobe-filling 0.08–0.

arxiv-2508-17878.title: Enhancing Speech Emotion Recognition with Multi-Task Learning and Dynamic Feature Fusion
arxiv-2508-17878.creator: Honghong, Jing, Fanqin, Rong
arxiv-2508-17878.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Honghong, Jing, Fanqin, Rong. This study investigates fine-tuning self-supervised learning (SSL) models using multi-task learning (MTL) to enhance speech emotion recognition (SER). The framework simultaneously handles four related tasks: emotion recognition, gender recognition, speaker verification, and automatic speech recognition. An innovative co-attention module is introduced to dynamically capture the interactions between features from the primary emotion classification task and auxiliary tasks, enabling context-aware fusion.

arxiv-2601-08528.creator: Yuchen Peng, Dingyu Yang, Zhongle Xie, Ji Sun, Lidan Shou, Ke Chen, Gang Chen
arxiv-2601-08528.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuchen Peng, Dingyu Yang, Zhongle Xie, Ji Sun, Lidan Shou, Ke Chen, Gang Chen. Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) underpins modern applications such as information retrieval and recommendation. With the rapid growth of vector data, efficient indexing for real-time vector search has become rudimentary.

arxiv-2601-21998.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
arxiv-2601-21998.creator: Lin Li ∗ Qihang Zhang ∗† Yiming Luo ∗ Shuai Yang Ruilin Wang Fei Han Mingrui Yu Zelin Gao Nan Xue Xing Zhu Yujun Shen Yinghao Xu ‡ ∗ Equal Contribution † Project Lead ‡ Corresponding Author
arxiv-2601-21998.description: Abstract This work highlights that video world modeling, alongside vision-language pre-training, establishes a fresh and independent foundation for robot learning. Intuitively, video world models provide the ability to “imagine” the near future by understanding the causality between actions and visual dynamics. Inspired by this, we introduce LingBot-VA , an autoregressive diffusion framework that learns frame prediction and policy execution simultaneously.

pmc-11455898.title: A cephalometric analysis of the antegonial notch in relation to the direction of mandibular growth
pmc-11455898.creator: Asuka Manabe, Keiko Fukino, Yuri Kinoshita, Norio Kitagawa, Joe Iwanaga, Takashi Ono
pmc-11455898.description: Masticatory muscle forces influence craniofacial morphology development. The antegonial notch (Notch) is a bony concavity on the inferior border of the mandible. Considering the Notch is located anteriorly to the insertion of the masseter muscle and varies among individuals, we hypothesised that these muscles influence the formation of the Notch.

pmc-11503906.title: Resolving Sulfation Posttranslational Modifications on a Peptide Hormone using Nanopores
pmc-11503906.creator: Xiuqi Chen, Jasper W. van de Sande, Justas Ritmejeris, Chenyu Wen, Henry Brinkerhoff, Andrew H. Laszlo, Bauke Albada, Cees Dekker
pmc-11503906.description: Peptide hormones are decorated with post-translational modifications (PTMs) that are crucial for receptor recognition. Tyrosine sulfation on plant peptide hormones is, for example, essential for plant growth and development. Measuring the occurrence and position of sulfotyrosine is, however, compromised by major technical challenges during isolation and detection. Nanopores can sensitively detect protein PTMs at the single-molecule level.

pmc-11692040.title: CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE RISK AND FALLS IN MEN AND WOMEN LIVING WITH AND WITHOUT HIV: MACS/WIHS COMBINED COHORT STUDY
pmc-11692040.creator: Elizabeth Vasquez, Mark Kuniholm, Allison Appleton, Anjali Sharma, Michael Yin, Todd Brown, Phyllis Tien, Deborah Gustafson
pmc-11692040.description: Falls risk assessment tools underestimate the risk among People Living with HIV (PLWH). The aim of this cross-sectional analysis was to measure associations between American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association (ACC/AHA) 10-year cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk scores and history of falls in a multi-center United States cohort of PLWH and similar people living without HIV (PLWOH).

pmc-12547347.title: Muscle-Invasive Bladder Paraganglioma: Case Report and Comprehensive Literature Review
pmc-12547347.creator: Rodrigo Escalante-Armenta, Juan Blanco-Gonzalez, Cristian-Axel Hernandez-Gaytan, Horst Emanuel Lagos Beitz, Guillermo Trujillo-Martinez, Guillermo H Martínez-Delgado, Brenda Bautista Martinez, Julian Arista, Ricardo A Castillejos-Molina
pmc-12547347.description: Bladder paragangliomas are rare neuroendocrine tumors that represent a minimal fraction of bladder neoplasms and often pose diagnostic challenges due to nonspecific symptoms. Arising from chromaffin tissue within the bladder wall, they may present with hematuria, paroxysmal hypertension, headache, or palpitations, frequently leading to misdiagnosis as other bladder tumors.

pmc-12734031.title: Cell Viability Assay of Chitosan-Modified Glass Ionomer Restorative Cements

Methods: Three different commercially available hand-mix GIC materials were used in this experiment: Fuji IX GP, Ketac Universal, and Riva Self Cure.

pmc-12735739.description: Stilbenes are a group of polyphenols that are gaining steady attention and have promising biological activity. While much attention is given to polyhydroxy compounds derived from resveratrol, other substituents remain largely unexplored. In this work, we present the results of studies on the synthesis, physicochemical characterisation, and ADME parameters simulation of polymethoxy and brominated stilbenes.

pmc-12739454.title: Changes in the Neighborhood Built Environment and Chronic Health Conditions in Washington, DC, in 2014-2019: Longitudinal Analysis
pmc-12739454.creator: Quynh C Nguyen, Riki Doumbia, Thu T Nguyen, Xiaohe Yue, Heran Mane, Junaid Merchant, Tolga Tasdizen, Mitra Alirezaei, Pankaj Dipankar, Dapeng Li, Penchala Sai Priya Mullaputi, Amrutha Alibilli, Yulin Hswen, Xin He
pmc-12739454.description: BackgroundGoogle Street View (GSV) images offer a unique and scalable alternative to in-person audits for examining neighborhood built environment characteristics. Additionally, most prior neighborhood studies have relied on cross-sectional designs.ObjectiveThis study aimed to use GSV images and computer vision to examine longitudinal changes in the built environment, demographic shifts, and health outcomes in Washington, DC, from 2014 to 2019.

pmc-13050972.title: Cannabis Use Disorder in the Era of Legalization: Implications for Addiction Treatment Systems
pmc-13050972.creator: Anees Bahji
pmc-13050972.description: IntroductionCannabis legalization has expanded rapidly across high-income jurisdictions, altering patterns of cannabis use, product potency, and commercial markets. Although surveillance systems increasingly quantify cannabis exposure, clinically meaningful harm is more difficult to detect. Cannabis use disorder (CUD) represents a key construct linking exposure to sustained impairment, yet its epidemiologic visibility depends heavily on diagnostic frameworks and measurement design.
